notes: Machine-readable policy for the VOLA dev engine (AI-SDLC). Reviewed in PRs like any code.
JSON, not YAML, deliberately: the validator (scripts/check-agent-policy.py) stays stdlib-only,
and the Go engine parses it with encoding/json — no dependency either side.
auto_merge.enabled stays false until the circuit-breaker/merge-policy engine exists;
the validator refuses true so flipping it is a deliberate two-file change, not a config drift.
